gen-dafont-galaxy-fs-amulya: Galaxy lays down tall, dense lowercase in one unbroken line width, spaced loosely. Amulya, a modern sans-serif with generous gaps in its curves, keeps paragraphs light and easy going as the lines stack up.
gen-dafont-galaxy-fs-chillax: Cosmic and commanding, Galaxy holds one unbroken line width and tall dense lowercase, while Chillax loops along like loose spaghetti. Chillax, a relaxed sans, makes extended text feel unhurried.
gen-dafont-galaxy-fs-roundo: Galaxy sets tall, dense lowercase with loose spacing and an unbroken line width, giving the top a cosmic, commanding look. Roundo keeps its geometric letters open and unclogged, so text flows smoothly.
gen-dafont-galaxy-gf-almendra: Starry, tall and unwavering: that's Galaxy up top. Almendra, a dignified serif with a deep midsection, adds bookish warmth underneath, so the unvarying Galaxy heading gets a gentler partner.
gen-dafont-galaxy-gf-port-lligat-slab: Commanding and cosmic, Galaxy cuts every letter at a single depth, tall and loosely spaced. Port Lligat Slab, a literary serif with wide porthole counters, reads traditional and snug over many lines.
gen-dafont-galaxy-gf-quando: Quando reads bookish and traditional, with wide, sparse spacing. Galaxy on top is the louder partner: a cosmic, commanding display face with tall, dense lowercase and an unbroken line width.
gen-dafont-galaxy-outfit: One unbroken line width runs through every Galaxy letter, tall and loosely spaced. Outfit, clean and approachable with cable-like curves, is made for settling in, where Galaxy is built to announce.
gen-dafont-galaxy-plus-jakarta-sans: Plus Jakarta Sans reads modern and precise, with monoline strokes. Galaxy up top brings the cosmic drama, tall and dense, while the sans-serif body keeps its curve endings well apart for easy flow.
gen-dafont-gobold-bitter: Wide-spaced and unyielding, Gobold leaves its curves open and keeps a constant stroke weight from the first letter to the last. Bitter, a grounded slab-serif, stays dependable line after line.
gen-dafont-gobold-gf-abyssinica-sil: Blunt, geometric and widely spaced, Gobold leaves its curves open and joins its strokes at full thickness. But Abyssinica SIL, a literary serif with a soft brushed shift in weight, adds a gentler voice beneath.
